events.name: Percidias
events.about: A mystery haunts the lands of Percidias, a world abandoned to its fate and filled with dangers born from ancient legends. Five adventurers, brought to this forgotten land, seek to uncover what the Crimson Storms fear the most.

events.name: Ashen Valley
events.about: Once a fertile valley, Ashen now lies in shadows, cursed by an ancient pact. A group of unlikely heroes must uncover the source of the blight before the land is lost forever.

events.name: Echoes of Elaris
events.about: In the shattered ruins of the elven kingdom of Elaris, whispers of a forgotten magic echo through the trees. A team of brave souls dares to walk the paths of ancient power, risking everything to restore the legacy of the First Elves.

events.name: The Hollow Throne
events.about: With the king assassinated and no heir in sight, the kingdom teeters on the brink of civil war. As chaos brews, a forgotten prophecy awakens and the Hollow Throne awaits its rightful ruler.

events.name: Nightfall in Drakemor
events.about: Darkness creeps across the realm as a forgotten dragon cult stirs beneath the city of Drakemor. A band of adventurers must descend into the catacombs and confront what lies beneath before night falls forever.

events.name: Crimson Seas
events.about: Set sail on the treacherous Crimson Seas, where ghost ships roam and treasure maps bleed. A fearless crew must chart a course through myth and betrayal in search of the Sea King's Crown.

events.name: Wyrmwatch Bastion
events.about: The mountain stronghold of Wyrmwatch stands as the last defense against an ancient dragon awakening. A group of defenders must rise and hold the line — or watch the world burn in dragonfire.
